5 تنزّر i. q. تَقَلَّلَ, (K,) i. e., It became diminished, or rendered little or small in quantity. (TK.) See also نَزُرَ. ―
-b2- He asserted himself to be related to the tribe of Nizár: (K:) or he made himself like that tribe: or he introduced himself among them, (S, K,) not being one of them. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
